/permissions.description: Edit organization profile, brands, tax profiles
Create/edit branches, opening hours, IP allow-lists
Start a gaming session on a station
Add time to a running session
Transfer a session to another station
Send a message to a station
Run actions on a whole zone/branch
Enter maintenance mode on a station
Configure shell layout, branding, allowed apps
Disable the locked shell on a station (unrestricted Windows)
Use privileged Windows tools in maintenance mode (cmd, PowerShell, regedit…)
Top up a customer's wallet (with payment)
Void items on an open order
Override a product's price at sale
Open cash drawer without a sale
View all shifts at the branch
Release, cancel and approve customers' print jobs

/roles.name: Branch Manager
/roles.description: Controls the venue: floor, staff shifts, approvals, local reports.

/roles.name: Cashier
/roles.description: Runs the front desk: sessions and sales.

/roles.name: Gaming Manager
/roles.description: Owns the gaming floor, stations, games and bookings.

/roles.name: Organization Admin
/roles.description: Runs the organization day-to-day; cannot change billing or payment gateways.

/roles.name: Organization Owner
/roles.description: Full control of the business, all branches.

/roles.name: System Administrator
/roles.description: IT: stations, shell, diskless, updates, integrations. No money handling.

/roles.name: Technician
/roles.description: Hardware & station maintenance; no sessions, no money.

/roles.name: Waiter
/roles.description: Takes and serves orders at tables and gaming seats.
